implementation_strategy: Hosted LLM generation (gpt-5-mini via openai_responses) for initial candidate and guarded repair; deterministic Dockerized verifier oracles (syntax-only baseline exemplar and guarded exemplar implementing syntax+policy+reachability/stateful checks) executed on CPU hosts. All orchestration, seeding, provenance checks, and scoring run in the execution harness; no human adjudication.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic confirmatory task selection from provenance-filtered corpus and seeded LLM-generated injections using fixed RNG seed (seed=20260826). Task list, seeds, and selection logs recorded and hashed in execution manifest.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline transform: direct_configuration_generation_v1 (single initial generation call). Guarded transform: generate_validate_repair_v1 (uses verifier trace output as repair context; integrates at most one repair call per task). All transforms deterministic and unit-tested in CI; provenance filtering and anonymization applied before inclusion.
randomisation_plan: All confirmatory-task selection and injection-variant assignment are deterministic using fixed RNG seed (seed=20260826). Seed, selection order, and deterministic hashes are recorded in execution manifest for reproducibility.
caching_plan: Cache all hosted-model responses and verifier outputs keyed by (task_id, seed, condition). Cached results reused for deterministic replays and CI tests. Cache stored and hashed in execution manifest.
failure_recovery_plan: Infrastructure failures flagged automatically and pairs with technical failures are excluded per 'complete_pair_primary'. For LLM-output contamination (similarity>0.9) or provenance-failure, the single allowed repair call per task (guarded condition) is used as deterministic re-seed; if both calls produce excluded outputs or verifier oracle/engine fails, the pair is excluded and logged. No human rerun or adjudication permitted.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1: per-task record contains task_id, seed, condition (baseline|guarded), verifier_trace (string, empty if none), detected (0/1), deterministic_hashes, timestamp, and provenance_url; paired outcome file contains both condition records per task and exclusion flags.
estimated_compute_notes: Totals derived from adapter contract: each task uses 1 initial generation call; guarded condition may invoke at most 1 repair call if initial candidate fails deterministic validation. With N=100 tasks, minimum calls =100 (no repairs), maximum =200 (repair for every task). We estimate 150 model calls (100 initial + expected 50 repair calls) = estimated_model_calls 150; maximum_model_calls = 100 * 2 = 200.
